faq.question: Is the application completely free?
faq.answer: Yes, it's completely free. In Free Mode, the entire process runs locally on your device, so no external services or cloud processing are required.

faq.question: Which file formats are supported?
faq.answer: We support PNG, JPEG, WebP, and AVIF. You can upload images in any supported format and download them in your preferred format.

faq.question: Does it work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes. The application works on all modern mobile browsers. Performance may vary depending on your device hardware.

faq.question: How do I remove downloaded models?
faq.answer: Downloaded AI models are stored in your browser cache and may consume significant disk space. You can remove cached models at any time from your account dashboard.

faq.question: Are there any limitations?
faq.answer: Because AI models run directly in your browser, performance depends on your device. Some models can use GPU acceleration for faster processing, while others rely primarily on the CPU, which may result in slower performance. Processing speed, memory usage, and model availability can vary across devices and browsers.

privacy-policy-page.title: Privacy <accent>Policy</accent>
privacy-policy-page.intro: Welcome to All AI Tools! We believe your privacy should be simple and respected. This policy explains how we handle your information.
privacy-policy-page.meta-description: Learn how All AI Tools protects your privacy, processes images client-side, and handles data.

local-processing.title: 1. Zero Server Uploads (Local AI)
local-processing.description: Most of our AI photo enhancement and editing features run entirely inside your browser. Your images are processed directly on your device and are never uploaded, stored, or analyzed on our servers.

data-collection.title: 2. What We Collect
data-collection.description: We do not require account registration to use our basic tools. We only collect details you voluntarily provide (like your email when sending feedback) and basic anonymous metadata (like browser version and device type) to ensure our in-browser models run smoothly.

data-usage.title: 3. How We Use Information
data-usage.description: Any basic diagnostic data is strictly used to optimize local browser processing performance. We never sell, rent, or monetize your personal details or images.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.description: We use local browser storage (such as IndexedDB) to temporarily cache the AI models and store your recent session edits. This data remains on your device. We may use simple cookies for site traffic analysis.

contact.title: 5. Get in Touch
contact.description: If you have any questions or want to request data deletion, email us at {email}. We represent the {siteName} team and are here to help.
